entries.caption:
We thought it was a dead world.

No atmosphere.
No rotation.
No measurable heat.

Then another planet passed too close.

The surface opened.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-005
entries.pinned_comment:
ANALYSIS NOTE:

The debris is not orbiting the object.

It is moving inward.

Nothing has escaped the pull.

entries.caption:
It passed Earth without slowing.

No signal.
No reaction.
No sign we mattered.

Then the course changed.

Less than one degree.

New orientation: Earth.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-006
entries.pinned_comment:
ANALYSIS NOTE:

Recorded course correction: < 1°.

The change was small enough to miss in real time.

New orientation: Earth.
